items.title: Christie’s to Auction Rare Louis Vuitton Artist Collaboration Bags
items.summary:
Summary 

Christie's New York is presenting an expansive collection of Louis Vuitton artist collaboration bags at auctionThe offering includes 100 rare pieces across 88 lots from renowned creatives like Takashi Murakami and Frank GehryThe private collection will be available during the Handbags and Fashion: The New York Edit event beginning November 25

Christie’s New York is set to present "Scarcity & Infinity: An Important Collection," featuring the most comprehensive assortment of Louis Vuitton artist collaboration bags ever offered at auction. Debuting as part of the December Luxury Week, the event highlights the French luxury fashion house’s historic partnerships with world-renowned artists, seamlessly blending the worlds of high fashion, contemporary art, and structural design.

The curated private collection explores the fluidity between fine art and contemporary fashion design. Comprising 100 pieces across 88 distinct lots, the auction ranges from reimagined iconic classics to highly rare modern creations. Standout items include Takashi Murakami ’s pink and white Artycapucines Mini Tentacles bag which is limited to a scarce edition of just 95, the piece carries an estimated value between $10,000 and $15,000 USD. Also featured is Frank Gehry ’s red and white Capucines MM Floating Fish, which draws direct inspiration from the fish lamps he designed for the Fondation Louis Vuitton, carrying an estimate of $6,000 to $8,000 USD along with key pieces from the Yayoi Kusama collaboration.

Since Marc Jacobs first invited artists to reinterpret the iconic Louis Vuitton…
items.t: Christie’s to Auction Rare Louis Vuitton Artist Collaboration Bags

items.title: Yayoi Kusama Sets a New Auction Record as Her 1960 Infinity Net Painting Fetches $14.7 Million USD
items.summary:
Summary 

Yayoi Kusama's 1960 painting No. 3P.B. shattered the artist's auction record with a $14.7 million final priceThe massive crimson canvas sparked a focused four-minute bidding war at Sotheby's New YorkThe historic posthumous benchmark arrives as the art market firmly secures her early minimalist legacy

The art market just delivered a definitive statement on the legacy of Yayoi Kusama . On Monday night, the late artist’s 1960 painting " No. 3P.B. " crossed the block at Sotheby’s New York, commanding a final price of $14.7 million USD including fees. Offered as Lot 110 during The Now and Contemporary Evening Auction, the artwork officially set a new auction record for the visionary Japanese creative . Standing more than five feet tall, the monumental artwork is a striking, meticulous execution of her most famous aesthetic. The crimson canvas features a dark ground completely enveloped from edge to edge in thousands of dense, tiny red looping brushstrokes.

A concentrated, high-stakes standoff on the auction floor produced the record-breaking transaction. The bidding war spanned exactly four minutes and comprised 10 total bids, driven entirely by two top executives representing clients on the phone. Evelyn Lin, the chairman of modern and contemporary art, Asia, traded steady escalating offers against Sotheby's chairman Lisa Dennison. Ultimately, Lin secured the winning bid for her buyer. The intense exchange pushed the painting to a hammer price of $12.5 million USD, a figure that landed squarely inside the house’s presale estimate of $10 million to $15 million.…
items.t: Yayoi Kusama Sets a New Auction Record as Her 1960 Infinity Net Painting Fetches $14.7 Million USD

items.title: Mercedes-Benz Is Bringing Hands-Free Highway Driving and Point-to-Point Navigation to the US
items.summary:
Summary 

Mercedes-Benz is launching hands-free highway driving and point-to-point navigation systems in the United StatesThe SAE Level 2 driver assistance technology marks a strategic shift away from early Level 3 autonomyA pilot program will begin for select California residents in December 2026 before a broader 2027 rollout

Mercedes-Benz is launching a pair of advanced driver assistance systems in the United States, rolling out hands-free highway driving alongside hands-on point-to-point navigation. These driver assistance systems are arriving as part of a continuing tech partnership with semiconductor company Nvidia. The introduction of these SAE Level 2 systems marks a shift in strategy for Mercedes-Benz. Three years ago, the automaker offered a pioneering Level 3 autonomy system in the United States, but that feature is no longer available on the latest S-Class. Stepping back from those short-lived Level 3 efforts, which Mercedes-Benz CTO Jörg Burzer described as "early", the luxury marque is recalibrating its approach to automation.

The hands-free highway driving system is limited to eligible roads for dedicated freeway use. Operating at speeds up to 85 miles per hour, the system handles highway driving and route decision-making. This functionality allows drivers to take their hands off the steering wheel, provided they maintain active supervision of the vehicle. In contrast, the hands-on point-to-point navigation system handles city driving workloads and reacts to dynamic traffic scenarios in real time. Because both new Mercedes-Benz features operate as SAE Level…
items.t: Mercedes-Benz Is Bringing Hands-Free Highway Driving and Point-to-Point Navigation to the US

items.title: The Nike Vomero 19 and Vaporfly 5 Shed Weight With New ZoomX and ReactX Foams
items.summary:
Summary 

Nike Running is previewing two new road shoes, a maximum-cushioned daily trainer and a race-day super shoe aimed at distances from 5K to the half marathonThe Vomero 19 pairs plush ZoomX with a new lightweight ReactX LT compound, losing weight while keeping the Vomero 18’s stack heightThe Vaporfly 5 places a new wave-shaped Flyplate between standard ZoomX and the new ZoomX LT, which is 17% lighter and returns 8% more energy

Nike has revealed the Vomero 19 and Vaporfly 5, two running shoes at opposite ends of the road lineup that both work toward the same goal of cutting weight. The Vomero 19 keeps the plush daily-trainer formula that defined its predecessor. The Vaporfly 5, still at the prototype stage, is Nike’s most aggressive version of its race shoe so far.

Nike takes a measured approach to the Vomero 19, keeping the cushioning, stability and familiar geometry of the Vomero 18 and fine-tuning around them. The midsole combines a soft layer of ZoomX with ReactX LT, a new lightweight compound that trims grams without lowering the stack height. Above the midsole, a seamless engineered mesh upper improves softness and airflow, and a reworked tongue and heel add padding where the foot needs support. A new radial outsole finishes the shoe, giving it better grip and a smoother transition from heel to toe.

The Vaporfly 5 is built around a new wave-shaped Flyplate. Its wider midfoot adds stability at speed, and an extended tip drives a more forceful toe-off. Nike surrounds the plate with two foams. Standard ZoomX sits below it, and the new ZoomX LT sits above it,…
items.t: The Nike Vomero 19 and Vaporfly 5 Shed Weight With New ZoomX and ReactX Foams

That idea comes to life in the Community Hall, a playground of interactive installations, collaborations and lifestyle experiences. At The Story House, spatial artist Kaiyi presents Ouro, an illuminated installation. Guests can explore the piece, then capture their own story through an immersive photography experience. Design-minded visitors can head to the ButNotReally pop-up for limited-edition festival merch, including custom-designed tees, retro MP3 players and squishies. To refresh a festival look, the Sephora x Hennessy Glam Bar has glam stations on-site.

The Hennessy Bar pours Hennessy cocktails on tap alongside a menu curated by Penang’s The Nest, home to two Hennessy MyWay champions. Both options are detailed with fringe beneath the tassels and classic leather stripes along the sides. Notably, the middle stripe extends over the forefoot to hold the tassels in place, while the heel tab mirrors the iconic design of the adidas Superstar.

Extending the two themes, the footwear is accompanied by matching apparel pieces. The assortment includes sweaters, chinos, and button-downs for the "Preppy" aesthetic, alongside black leather jackets that channel the rebellious youth energy of the "Yankee" style.

items.title: WIND AND SEA and the NBA’s “The Legacy Continues” Collection Puts Game Mesh on Chino

WIND AND SEA and the NBA team up on a 10-piece collection built around the New York Knicks, Los Angeles Lakers, Philadelphia 76ers and San Antonio SpursTrack jackets and pants pair classic chino with basketball game mesh, while the hoodies use a double-layered build to give a layered look in one garmentEach team’s signature colors guide its version of the range, which extends past apparel into knit caps, belts, blankets and bracelets

WIND AND SEA has partnered with the NBA on “The Legacy Continues,” a collection that gives four of the league’s most storied franchises their own versions of the same 10-piece lineup. The Tokyo label anchors the drop in its fabric choices. The track jackets and pants use a sturdy chino base, then add the open-knit mesh found on game-day jerseys, so the court reference shows up in the textile itself.

The track sets do most of the technical work. Chino gives the jackets and pants a structured, workwear-leaning body, and the game mesh adds a lighter, more breathable texture taken straight from basketball uniforms. In the lookbook, the mesh appears as a contrast band across the chest of the Spurs jacket, and the Knicks set uses orange stripes over a deep blue base.The hoodies follow the same layering idea in a different form. Their double-layered construction gives the look of two garments stacked together in a single piece.

The rest of the collection fills out a complete team kit: sweatpants, short- and long-sleeve T-shirts, a knit cap, a belt, a blanket and a bracelet. Every item comes in all four team versions, and each version…

The 2027 GRAMMY nominations have officially been announced, with RAYE leading the field with 11 nods, including Record, Album and Song of the Year. That total ties the record Beyoncé set in 2025 for the most nominations earned by a female artist in one year. Rosalía comes in close behind with nine for Lux , and each one marks her first nomination in that category.

Ella Langley is next with seven nominations, helped by “Choosin’ Texas,” which recently set the record for the most weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100. Miranda Lambert co-wrote that song, and she also earned seven nominations, as did Olivia Rodrigo and Phoebe Bridgers.

Album of the Year is an eight-way race. Marvel Studios president Kevin Feige is officially celebrating 25 years of superhero history by returning to the beginning, confirming that several original characters will make their Marvel Cinematic Universe debut in Avengers: Doomsday . Hitting theaters this December, the highly anticipated crossover event will feature the return of foundational franchise stars, including James Marsden as Cyclops, Rebecca Romijn as Mystique, and Patrick Stewart as Professor X.

Speaking with Empire in a recent interview, Feige reflected on the long-awaited crossover between the two iconic superhero teams. “You see interviews of Hugh Jackman 15, 20 years ago saying, ‘People say it’s impossible, but maybe someday the X-Men and the Avengers can all get together.’ It just felt right,” Feige explained. “It just felt like the fun way to culminate a quarter-century of storytelling.”

items.title: Devin Booker Debuts the Nike Book 3 "Twilight" on Court
items.summary:
Summary 

Devin Booker has officially debuted his upcoming third signature sneaker on the hardwoodThe Nike Book 3 was unveiled in a sleek all-black colorway dubbed TwilightAn official release date and pricing details remain unconfirmed by the sportswear brand

Nike and Phoenix Suns guard Devin Booker have unofficially unveiled the highly anticipated Nike Book 3 . Giving fans an early look at his third signature shoe, the athlete debuted the unreleased model on the court in a stealthy all-black "Twilight" colorway.

Due to the blacked-out makeup of the "Twilight" iteration, the specific technical elements and nuanced design details remain difficult to discern. However, early on-court glimpses suggest that the forthcoming silhouette maintains the fairly simple, streamlined design language established by its predecessors, bypassing the bulky and futuristic aesthetic commonly found in modern performance basketball footwear.

The appearance of the third iteration indicates a potential shift in Booker’s signature release schedule. Following the nearly two-year lifecycle of the original silhouette and the early 2026 retail arrival of the Book 2, this late-year on-court debut suggests a pivot toward a more traditional annual release cadence. As Nike has yet to officially announce the sneaker, the performance details and the public availability of the "Twilight" colorway remain unknown.

Sperry and BEAMS PLUS have officially joined forces once more to reimagine the iconic Sperry x BEAMS PLUS MIL CVO. Blending the American footwear brand's deep maritime and military heritage with the Japanese label's masterful interpretation of classic Americana, the limited-edition collection elevates the 1935 silhouette with premium, tactile textures.

Drawing direct inspiration from classic Americana suede coats and archival core colors, the latest iteration of the Circular Vamp Oxford swaps traditional canvas for a soft, saturated suede upper. Available in tan, navy, and white, the refined material choice lends the utilitarian silhouette a slightly dressier, sophisticated feel while honoring the design's original connection to footwear issued to the U.S. Navy during World War II.

"The idea behind this collection was to ‘dress up’ the sneaker—a blend of sneaker ease and leather-shoe refinement," explained BEAMS PLUS director Hideki "Harry" Mizobata. "Sperry’s CVO heritage gave us the freedom to reinterpret the style, exploring the balance between casual comfort and classic sophistication." By contemporizing these military-inspired elements, the collaboration offers a fresh expression of both brands' shared affinity for heritage and everyday…

Summary 

Hypebeast's Anisah Moosa spent 72 hours exploring Madrid with Marriott Bonvoy, following NFL star Jessie Bates’ favorite local spots.From neighborhood restaurants to historic landmarks, Marriott Bonvoy’s NFL City Guides took us beyond the stadium.The trip concluded with an NFL showdown between the Atlanta Falcons and Cincinnati Bengals at Madrid’s iconic Santiago Bernabéu Stadium.

There's no better way to experience a new city than through the recommendations of someone who knows it best. And while Madrid has no shortage of things to see, eat, and explore, we had a little help narrowing down our itinerary.

As part of its partnership with the NFL , Marriott Bonvoy introduced 37 player-curated City Guides, inviting fans to discover destinations beyond the stadium through the eyes of some of the league's biggest names. From restaurants and local hangouts to cultural landmarks, each guide offers a more personal look at the cities that host NFL games around the world.

For our 72 hours in Madrid, we followed the recommendations of Atlanta Falcons safety Jessie Bates III , whose guide highlights some of his favorite spots across the Spanish capital. With Marriott Bonvoy as our host, we set out to experience the city's food, neighborhoods, and culture before closing out the trip with an NFL game at the iconic Santiago Bernabéu Stadium.

items.summary:
Streetwear fundamentally altered luxury and contemporary fashion, but its influence is now splintering into exciting new territories. Today’s style culture is defined by fluid self-expression: music subcultures, West Coast nostalgia, European tailoring, and high-level material craftsmanship all converge into one singular narrative. Men are no longer dressing for rigid occasions or hiding behind uniform silhouettes; instead, they are mixing dramatic proportions with tactile luxury and relaxed elegance. Bloomingdale’s Fall/Winter 2026 collection serves as the ultimate hub for this movement, spotlighting a new wave of design labels taking subcultural codes into sophisticated, elevated realms. 

The West Coast energy that once defined early streetwear has matured into a full-fledged expression of modern luxury. Rhude illustrates this evolution seamlessly, translating speed culture and Americana into elevated off-duty layers like their Desert Graphic-Print Hoodie and Desert Racing Track Jacket . Nearby in the California landscape, Nahmias captures youth subculture through a refined lens with their MVP Logo Star Cotton Crewneck Sweatshirt and the luxurious Loose Fit MVP Leather Bomber Jacket . Meanwhile, Amiri bridges rock-and-roll heritage with haute luxury, executing decadent details in the Beaded Micro Stars Wool & Cashmere Cardigan paired back to essential Vintage Fit Flock Jeans . 

Across the Atlantic, Parisian and Scandinavian influences bring an understated sophistication to modern wardrobing. AMI champions relaxed tailoring and effortless French charm, anchoring current…
items.t: Bloomingdale’s Casual Roots and Refined Tailoring Collide to Build the Blueprint for Modern Men’s Dressing

items.title: CART X Makes History at Retromobile's First New York Edition
items.summary:
Summary 

Retromobile celebrates its 50th anniversary with its first US edition at New York City's Javits Center from November 19–22.CART Department debuts CART X, featuring art cars and works by Keith Haring, Ai Weiwei, Damien Hirst, Jeff Koons and more.CART X partners with Public School New York on custom uniforms and exclusive merchandise, bridging automotive culture, art and fashion.

A new chapter in automotive and cultural history is unfolding in New York City as Retromobile , the renowned French collector car salon, makes its American debut after five decades in Paris. Taking place at the Javits Center from November 19 to 22, 2026, the landmark event will also mark the launch of CART X, a new global platform by CART Department exploring the intersection of automobiles, art, fashion, music and popular culture.

Founded in Paris in 1976, Retromobile has grown from a gathering of automotive enthusiasts and collectors into one of the world's leading celebrations of automotive heritage. Now marking its 50th anniversary, the renowned salon expands beyond France for the first time, bringing its legacy of rare and historic vehicles to New York City.

Founded by art collector Larry Warsh, CART Department marks a major milestone with the debut of CART X, a new global platform exploring the automobile as both an artistic canvas and cultural artifact. The presentation features art cars and works by Keith Haring, Ai Weiwei, Jeff Koons, Shepard Fairey, Damien Hirst, Zaha Hadid, Barbara Kruger, Daniel Arsham, Esther Mahlangu, Olafur Eliasson, Richard Prince and Kenny Scharf.…
items.t: CART X Makes History at Retromobile's First New York Edition

items.title: Sorel Pushes Its Icons Forward With the “Age of Discovery” Collection
items.summary:
On the eve of its 65th anniversary year, Sorel is heading into Fall/Winter 2026 with its “Age of Discovery” collection, a lineup that merges the brand’s heritage with new innovation. At its center are three new men’s styles: the Callsign Enigma GTX sneaker, the Daystorm Horizon Zip GTX boot and the Caribou Horizon Zip GTX boot. Each one pairs arctic-grade performance with a sharper, street-ready attitude.

The Callsign Enigma GTX blends street style with outdoor grit. A waterproof GORE-TEX® textile upper is finished with a leather mudguard and a gusseted rubberized zip shroud. Speed laces with a cord-lock and SOREL-branded aglets handle the closure, and reflective SOREL branding runs along both quarters. Underfoot, a lightweight molded LIVELYFOAM midsole and a removable Ortholite footbed sit on a Vibram XS TREK EVO outsole. The sneaker comes in “Black/Black,” “Tawny Buff/Black” and “Deep Woods/Bleached Ceramic.”

Built to stand firm in the storm, the Daystorm Horizon Zip GTX, in a “Black/Tawny Buff” colorway, combines full-grain leather with patented GORE-TEX® fully waterproof construction. A removable zip shroud lets wearers switch up the look, while a molded rubber midsole and Vibram XS TREK EVO outsole bring the traction.

Rounding out the trio, the Caribou Horizon Zip GTX reimagines one of Sorel’s most legendary silhouettes for today. A suede and full-grain leather upper sits atop an injected rubber shell and features a removable zip shroud, a custom zipper and military lacing. items.summary:
Holiday gifting rarely goes to plan. Between last-minute runs and the dreaded “it’s the thought that counts” reaction, finding something that actually lands can feel like a sport of its own. This holiday season, Lids is making the case for a trip to the mall with the upcoming in-store release of its New Era Realtree collection.

The collection adds two new fabrics to the Lids assortment, the New Era Realtree Excape and New Era Pink Realtree, and puts them on classic fitted and A-Frame silhouettes. The result is a fresh take on traditional camouflage that keeps team identity front and center, with styles spanning MLB, NFL, NBA and NHL teams.

Leading the lineup is the 59FIFTY New Era Realtree Excape. It works tonal team-color details into the print with metallic thread, so logos blend naturally into the camo while still giving a subtle point of contrast. The New Era Excape 9FORTY A-Frame comes in two distinct colorways. The New Era Chrome/Realtree version pairs a classic palette with a mix of throwback and alternate team logos. The second is built on a brown crown, a nod to the color’s recent run of popularity that sits naturally alongside the New Era Realtree pattern.

For something brighter, the New Era Pink Realtree brings the new fabric to the classic New Era 59FIFTY fitted. It also carries over to the New Era 9FORTY A-Frame, where the pattern meets team branding for a fashion-forward take on fan headwear.

items.title: The 14 best men’s boots for winter, from chelseas and lace-ups to wellies
items.summary:
Whether you want minimalist or heritage, waterproof or suede, our menswear expert has rounded up the most stylish pairs for every occasion and outfit

• The best men’s coats for autumn and winter

I haven’t always worn boots. For years I wrote them off – at 5ft 8in, I was convinced anything above the ankle would make my legs look shorter. Then I started wearing them with the right trousers – a straight leg that falls over the top – and realised I’d spent a decade getting winter wrong. All anyone sees is a smart pair of shoes that happens to keep your ankles warm.

Here’s the thing: boots needn’t be intimidating. They’re just the wintry version of the leather shoes you already own. A chelsea is your loafer – it goes with pretty much everything in your wardrobe and every event in your diary, Christmas parties included. A derby boot is laced up, a bit sturdier and just as happy with jeans. The chukka is your weekend trainer. And the chunky, rubber-soled ones? Just think of them as an umbrella for your feet.
